items.duty_text: Conduct a study regarding burial capacity on Hart Island in collaboration with the commissioner of parks and recreation and the head of any other relevant agency.
Identify current burial procedures on Hart Island concerning the specified burial areas, trench placement and dimensions, and the depth and placement of graves and caskets.

If the commissioner determines that there should be changes in burial procedures on Hart Island, develop recommendations pertaining to those changes and justifications for the recommendations.
